fields.Name: CalculateRunCost
fields.UserQuestion: What is the total cost, token usage, and number of prompts for an AI Agent Run including all its sub-agent runs?
fields.Description: Calculates comprehensive cost metrics for an AI Agent Run, including all nested sub-agent runs. Returns total cost, token usage (input/output), and prompt count by recursively traversing the agent run hierarchy.
fields.TechnicalDescription: This query uses a Common Table Expression (CTE) to recursively traverse the AI Agent Run hierarchy, starting from a specified root agent run and including all nested sub-agent runs up to 20 levels deep. It then joins with AI Agent Run Steps to find all prompt executions and calculates aggregate cost and token metrics. The query uses template parameters for the MJ Core schema name and agent run ID to ensure compatibility across different environments.

fields.Name: AIAgentRunID
fields.Description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the starting AI Agent Run to calculate costs for.

fields.Name: AgentRunID
fields.Description: The ID of the starting AI Agent Run
fields.ComputationDescription: Projected directly from the AIAgentRunID parameter

fields.Name: TotalCost
fields.Description: Total cost of the agent runs in the hierarchy
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN f.IsPriced = 1 AND f.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN f.OwnCost END) aggregate from AIUsageFacts

fields.Name: TotalPrompts
fields.Description: Total number of prompts executed, excluding parallel parent runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN f.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) aggregate from AIUsageFacts

fields.Name: TotalTokensInput
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN f.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN f.TokensPrompt ELSE 0 END) aggregate from AIUsageFacts

fields.Name: TotalTokensOutput
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN f.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN f.TokensCompletion ELSE 0 END) aggregate from AIUsageFacts

fields.Name: TotalTokens
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN f.IsParallelParent = 0 THEN f.TokensPrompt + f.TokensCompletion ELSE 0 END) aggregate from AIUsageFacts

fields.Name: Server Installed Version History
fields.UserQuestion: Show me a list of versions installed on the server in order of most recent version first

fields.Name: installed_rank
fields.Description: Unique sequential identifier for each migration entry
fields.ComputationDescription: Row number ordered by installed_on DESC

fields.Name: version
fields.Description: Flyway version identifier for the migration

fields.Name: checksum
fields.Description: Checksum value for the migration script

fields.Name: installed_by
fields.Description: Database user that installed the migration

fields.Name: installed_on
fields.Description: Timestamp when the migration was installed

fields.Name: execution_time
fields.Description: Time in milliseconds for the migration to execute

fields.Name: success
fields.Description: Whether the migration completed successfully (1) or failed (0)
